grace_gravity.name: NASA GRACE Gravity Anomaly
grace_gravity.description: Temporal gravity field variations from GRACE/GRACE-FO satellites

goes_gravity_waves.name: NOAA GOES IR Atmospheric Gravity Waves
goes_gravity_waves.description: Concentric wave patterns in GOES water vapor imagery without known meteorological cause

indigenous_sacred_sites.name: Indigenous Sacred Sites

nighttime_lights.name: NOAA VIIRS Nighttime Lights (Industrial Mask)

faa_wildlife_strikes.name: FAA Wildlife Strike Database

water_wells.name: USGS NWIS Groundwater Monitoring Wells

adsb_traffic.name: ADS-B Aircraft Traffic (Noise Control)

space_weather.name: NOAA Space Weather Events (Solar Control)
